programs.title: Renovation Nation
programs.desc: In Warwickshire, Andrew and Mandy discover hidden treasures. Drew's Cornish Regency villa is almost complete. And Steve and Sally create a garden room with a view.

programs.title: Chateau DIY
programs.desc: Tim and Sasha are like fish out of water as they take on a new water feature in the garden. Alison and Zion add a Moroccan twist in the bridal suite, Becky and Mark are in a tight squeeze battling to move a spiral staircase into their gite.

programs.title: The Block
programs.desc: Its a busy time on The Block with the terraces nearing completion. Scotty and Shelley pay the teams one last on site visit before they complete their renovation and life on a building site is uncomfortable for everyone as heatwave sets in.

programs.title: Down Home Fab
programs.desc: Chelsea and Cole mix business and friendship as they renovate their friend's 1920s bungalow.

programs.title: Escape To The Chateau
programs.desc: The whole family help to build an open kitchen and create a pop-up restaurant in the orangery to celebrate Dick and Angel's fifth wedding anniversary. Plus: a special fairy-tale carriage delivery.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: Queens Newlyweds Take on the King's London
programs.desc: A job opportunity sends a pair of Queens newlyweds to royal London. They're hoping to chase the quintessential British experience, but the reality of the transition may prove to be trickier than the dream.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: Now that their kids are grown, a couple looks to start a new chapter and move to the Mississippi Gulf Coast. He wants a cozy beach cottage, but she's willing to break the bank and prefers a newer, modern house.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: Dreams vs. Dollars in New York
programs.desc: A couple has outgrown their rental and looks to buy a home for their family in Rockland County, New York. She wants to fulfill her dream of buying a grand Colonial, but he's more cautious with spending and wants to make sure they stay within their budget.

programs.title: Home Town Takeover
programs.desc: Dave and Jenny focus on a young couple who want to use their trendy clothing business to inspire the youth to invest in Fort Morgan; Ben and Erin look to help the town thrive with a special project to lure people off the nearby motorway.

programs.title: Good Bones
programs.sub_title: Starting From Scratch in the Old Southside
programs.desc: Mina and Karen take on an abandoned fire-damaged home. They realise the only way to fix it is to demolish the house and start from scratch. The duo pulls out all the stops to revitalize this rebuild with French-inspired design.

programs.title: Fix My Frankenhouse
programs.desc: With an expanding family of two kids and a new puppy, a couple's house has become cramped and needs a reconfiguration; it's up to Mike and Denese to reimagine their home to give them the entertaining space they need, along with a new main suite.

programs.title: The Nate And Jeremiah Home Project
programs.desc: A couple starts a new chapter with their blended family, but they've faced major hardships, including an electrical fire that has left their home unlivable; Nate and Jeremiah help them move on from the past.
